title: Beyond Demographics: Fine-tuning Large Language Models to Predict Individuals’ Subjective Text Perceptions
reasoning: The paper investigates how well LLMs can be fine-tuned to predict subjective human perceptions (like intimacy, offensiveness, and safety) based on sociodemographics. While it touches on 'safety' and 'offensiveness', it does so through the lens of predicting individual human variation rather than evaluating religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
